gen-dafont-gobold-fs-asap: Heavy-handed and wide-spaced: Gobold's crossbars weigh exactly what its stems do, while Asap's curves stay open. Gobold is made to announce; Asap is the plain sans made for reading.
gen-dafont-gobold-general-sans: Gobold spreads its stubborn, unclosed curves wide across the line, while General Sans fills its lines with a smooth, steady pen. Loud letterforms meet a quiet plain sans, and neither crowds the other.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-fauna-one: Chunky and brash: Gobold's curves never quite close, and Fauna One's serif letters stand tall with a generous entry into the e. Gobold is made to command; Fauna One is made to be lingered over.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-glegoo: Editorial letters with big counters and unclosed curves sit under Gobold, whose bowls never thin at the sides. Glegoo keeps paragraphs moving with an easy, open texture that doesn't tire the eye.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-hanuman: Gobold looks drawn with a single pen tip, its curves refusing to close and its letters spaced far apart. Hanuman, a refined serif with a high-waisted lowercase, keeps the page traditional.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-kadwa: Gobold's stroke ends are as wide as its middles, flat and blunt. Kadwa, with open-ended curves and a large x-height, is the sharpest foil: all flowing where Gobold stays blunt.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, its curved letters taking a visible run-in and its lowercase filling most of the height. And Gobold, cut flat like a stencil from single-weight strokes, gives it something blunt to push against.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Gobold, with a line that glides under the eye like wire, earns its keep in big, short bursts.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-pridi: Refined without fuss, this classic serif keeps generous gaps between curve ends and stems, set against Gobold's pipe-like strokes. Pridi lets paragraphs unspool with a settled, patient feel, its small letters nearly capital-sized.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-scope-one: Broad and unbending: Gobold's joins don't thin where strokes meet, while Scope One's counters spill out into the surrounding space. And where Gobold exists to be seen, this classic serif exists to carry the words.
